RootMetadata.title: Khareej Qader - Areisto Academy
RootMetadata.description: A training program aimed at qualifying graduates for the labor market

HeroSection.description: A practical training program designed for university students, helping you acquire real skills, carry out tasks under the supervision of trainers, and obtain a certificate that qualifies you for the job market.

About.title: Learn about Khareej Qader Program
About.subtitle: The most comprehensive specialized training program in the region to support your career ambition.
About.description: We are here to move you from university seats to the field of the labor market with confidence and professionalism.

HowItWorks.title: How does Khareej Qader Program work?
HowItWorks.subtitle: Simple steps that lead you to your professional goal and make you able to compete.
HowItWorks.step1_desc: Apply via the website and we will review your application and choose the most suitable according to the criteria.
HowItWorks.step2_desc: An appointment will be set for a personal interview to assess your skills and passion to join.
HowItWorks.step3_desc: Your intensive training journey will begin with expert trainers and real practical applications.
HowItWorks.step4_desc: You will receive an accredited certificate and start your career journey with confidence in the labor market.

Features.title: Why is Khareej Qader the perfect choice for you?
Features.subtitle: We provide you with an integrated environment that guarantees your professional and technical excellence.
Features.f1_desc: Trainers with extensive experience in the Gulf and global labor market.
Features.f2_desc: Training content that keeps pace with the latest technical and global requirements.
Features.f3_desc: A certificate that enhances your CV and greatly supports your employment opportunities.
Features.f4_desc: Direct interaction and practical applications on real projects on the ground.
Features.f5_desc: A strong network of relationships with major companies and leading institutions.
Features.f6_desc: Post-graduation follow-up to help you get the best opportunities.

Tracks.title: Explore Training Tracks
Tracks.subtitle: Choose the path that suits your passion and start your journey now.
Tracks.track1_desc: Learn to build modern websites and applications using the latest technologies such as React and Node.js from start to professional.
Tracks.track2_desc: Design professional user experiences and attractive, easy-to-use interfaces by learning the basics of visual research and prototyping.
Tracks.track3_desc: Learn campaign management, performance analysis, and achieving effective marketing results using advanced analysis tools and social platforms.

Testimonials.title: Real Success Stories from our Students
Testimonials.subtitle: We are proud of what our graduates have achieved in their careers.
Testimonials.quote1: I learned how to think as a designer, not just how to use tools. The methodology followed completely changed my perspective on user experience.

FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.subtitle: Answers to the most common questions you may have about the program
FAQ.q1: How can I join the program?
FAQ.a1: You can apply by clicking on the 'Register Now' button and filling in the required data.
FAQ.a2: We look for passion, seriousness, and commitment to attending accredited training hours.
FAQ.q3: Is the program for graduates only?
FAQ.a3: The program is specifically for final-year students and fresh graduates.
